scope: Pinned NX809J build only; this does not establish safety for a kernel built with CONFIG_OF_DYNAMIC=y.

drivers/of/Kconfig.finding: OF_DYNAMIC is a bool with no default; it is selected only on platforms/features that require dynamic trees.

include/linux/of.h.finding: When CONFIG_OF_DYNAMIC is undefined, of_node_get(node) returns node and of_node_put(node) is empty.

drivers/of/base.c.finding: of_get_next_available_child delegates to the child traversal that calls of_node_get(next) and of_node_put(prev); under this config both are no-ops.

stock_evidence: Ghidra decompilation of nb_fan_parse_dt shows repeated of_get_next_available_child calls and no explicit of_node_put; that is safe for this pinned config because OF_DYNAMIC reference counting is compiled out.
disposition: No source change needed for pinned target. If CONFIG_OF_DYNAMIC is enabled in another target build, re-evaluate the child traversal and add balanced references before claiming lifecycle safety.
